gloss: mixed rice, seasoned rice cooked with ingredients

definitions.explanation: Rice cooked together with various ingredients like vegetables, meat, or seafood, seasoned with soy sauce and dashi.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{栗|くり}→栗：04387_kuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{炊|た}き{込|こ}みご{飯|はん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: Chestnut mixed rice is delicious in autumn.

examples.japanese: {炊|た}き{込|こ}みご{飯|はん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{炊飯器|すいはんき}→炊飯器：04972_suihanki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made mixed rice in the rice cooker.
I like chicken and burdock root mixed rice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧{炊|た}き{込|こ}みご{飯|はん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: My mother's mixed rice is the best.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旬|しゅん}→旬：12716_shun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧{炊|た}き{込|こ}みご{飯|はん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}ると→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧、⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: If you make mixed rice using seasonal vegetables, you can enjoy the flavors of the season.

notes:
{炊|た}き{込|こ}みご{飯|はん} is rice cooked together with ingredients and seasonings (⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧, ⟦{出汁|だし}→出汁：04917_dashi⟧, etc.) in the same pot. A staple of Japanese home cooking, often made seasonally.

POPULAR VARIETIES:
- ⟦{栗|くり}→栗：04387_kuri⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧: chestnut rice (⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧)
- ⟦{筍|たけのこ}→筍：17667_takenoko⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧: bamboo shoot rice (⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧)
- ⟦{松茸|まつたけ}→松茸：13119_matsutake⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧: matsutake mushroom rice
- ⟦{鯛|たい}→鯛：14709_tai⟧⟦めし→飯：03805_meshi⟧: sea bream rice
- ⟦{鶏|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦ごぼう→牛蒡：13484_gobou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{炊|た}き{込|こ}みご{飯|はん}: chicken and burdock root rice

SIMILAR TERMS:
- ⟦{混|ま}ぜご{飯|はん}→混ぜご飯：29034_mazegohan⟧: rice mixed with ingredients after cooking (different technique)
- {炊|た}き{込|こ}みご{飯|はん}: ingredients cooked together with the rice from the start
The two are sometimes used interchangeably in casual speech.

CULTURE:
Often associated with seasonal cooking (⟦{旬|しゅん}→旬：12716_shun⟧). Making {炊|た}き{込|こ}みご{飯|はん} with seasonal ingredients is a way to enjoy the changing seasons through food.
